title: Graydon Exception to Public Bidding - Microsoft Volume Licensing Agreement, Enrollment - Softchoice, Inc. - Technology Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2526-0153 - Authorizing Use Of Graydon Exception To Public Bidding for Contract With Softchoice, Inc. and Approving Microsoft Volume Licensing Program Signature Form - Agreement No. 5523254, Microsoft Volume Licensing Enrollment for Education Solutions Enrollment No. 91813868 (Previously 48378984), via Softchoice, Inc. headline: Renews district-wide Microsoft licenses through Softchoice for up to $190,447.29 a year
summary: The district would buy its Microsoft software licenses through the reseller Softchoice for three years, up to $190,447.29 each year and $571,341.87 in total. headline: Denies Yu Ming Charter School's Proposition 2 facilities application for the Tilden site
summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that denies approval of Yu Ming Charter School's application to the Proposition 2 Charter School Facilities Program. The application is for District property at 4551 Steele Street in Oakland, also called the Tilden Site.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted

title: Denial - Proposition 2 Charter School Facilities Program Application - East Bay Innovation Academy
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2526-0185 - Denying Approval of Proposition 2 Charter School Facilities Program Application of East Bay Innovation Academy for both new construction and rehabilitation projects at 3400 Malcolm Avenue in Oakland.
headline: Denies East Bay Innovation Academy's Proposition 2 facilities application for 3400 Malcolm Avenue
summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that denies approval of East Bay Innovation Academy's application to the Proposition 2 Charter School Facilities Program. The application covers both new construction and rehabilitation projects at 3400 Malcolm Avenue in Oakland.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (6–1), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted

group: Measures N and H Commission - October 7, 2025 - David Kakishiba, Chair

presenter: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission

group: Measures N and H Commission - October 7, 2025 - David Kakishiba, Chair
title: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission - Amended - Oakland School for the Arts - 2025-2026 Education Improvement Plan/Budget
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation by the Measures N and H Commission, of the amended 2025-2026 Education Improvement Plan for Oakland School for the Arts with a base allocation of $287,300.00 and a strategic carryover plan and budget of $35,403.91, in a total amount not to exceed $322,703.91.

title: Measure G1 - Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission - Carryover Allocations for Named Schools – School Year 2024 - 2025
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2526-0183 Measure G1 - Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission Recommendation - Approving 2024 - 2025 Measure G1 Allocations for Named Schools and for OUSD and Charter Schools’ Teacher Salaries (In Part).

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Soccer Without Borders - English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Soccer Without Borders, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Year-round after-school and weekend soccer programs, including bi-weekly soccer training sessions and weekly games, for middle school and high school-aged boys; school day academic and socio-emotional support, including academic tracking, socio-emotional learning groups, tutoring, mentorship, and school reengagement support; and Community building trips including team hikes, camping trips, college visits and trips to professional and college soccer games [these activities for newcomer OUSD students at the following sites: Castlemont, Fremont, Rudsdale, Oakland High School, Oakland International High School, Frick Middle School, Urban Promise Academy Middle School, and San Antonio Park (serving Roosevelt students and newcomer students from other middle school sites)], via English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department, for the period of September 15, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $277,000.00.
funding_source: PHI Afghan Refugee Schl Impact; CalNEW Grant CDSS
headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $277,000 for newcomer student soccer, tutoring and mentoring
summary: Soccer Without Borders would run after-school and weekend soccer, school-day academic and emotional support, and community trips for newcomer students at eight sites, from September 15, 2025 through June 30, 2026. The services include tutoring, mentoring and help for students returning to school. The cost may not exceed $277,000.00.
schools: Castlemont; Fremont; Rudsdale; Oakland High School; Oakland International High School; Frick Middle School; Urban Promise Academy Middle School; San Antonio Park
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement for Engineering Services – Atlas Technical Consultants, LLC - Fremont High School Modernization Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of the Agreement for Engineering Services by and between the District and Atlas Technical Consultants, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to continue to provide geotechnical engineering and observation services, as delineated in Exhibit C of the Agreement, for the Fremont High School Modernization  Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $6,842.50, with work scheduled to commence on October 23, 2025, and scheduled to end June 30, 2026.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays Atlas Technical Consultants up to $6,842.50 for geotechnical work at Fremont High modernization
summary: Atlas Technical Consultants would continue providing soil and ground engineering and observation services for the Fremont High School modernization project. Work is scheduled from October 23, 2025 to June 30, 2026. The cost may not exceed $6,842.50.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – DecoTech Systems, Inc. – Lockwood Network Infrastructure Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and DecoTech Systems, Inc., Walnut Creek, CA, for the latter to install fiber optic cabling and integrate the network system of Lockwood STEAM Academy Main Distribution Frame and College Coliseum Preparatory Academy Main Distribution Frame for the Lockwood Network Infrastructure Project, as delineated in Exhibit A of the Agreement, in the not to exceed amount of $44,925.51, with the work scheduled to commence on October 23, 2025, and scheduled to last until December 30, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays DecoTech Systems up to $44,925.51 to install fiber optic network cabling at two schools
summary: DecoTech Systems would install fiber optic cabling and connect the main network equipment rooms at Lockwood STEAM Academy and College Coliseum Preparatory Academy. Work is scheduled from October 23, 2025 to December 30, 2025. The cost may not exceed $44,925.51.
schools: Lockwood STEAM Academy; College Coliseum Preparatory Academy
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
